modern: To her who gives and takes back all, to nature, the man who is instructed and modest says: Give what you will; take back what you will. And he says this not proudly, but obediently, and well pleased with her.
original: To her who gives and takes back all, to nature, the man who is instructed and modest says, Give what thou wilt; take back what thou wilt. And he says this not proudly, but obediently, and well pleased with her.
